description: Bittensor dTAO copy trading — mirror subnet allocations of top performers; the leaderboard and every read are served by the bt module's local index (public RPCs as fallback), a strat agent you can talk to builds the baskets, and an MCP server (POST /mcp) drives the book — create copies, sync the portfolio, backtest

/account/{ss58}/curve.docs: Equity/PnL curve from local snapshots, with inferred trades pinned to the curve (?days=7)

/agent.docs: Strat-agent status — auth, model, and the tools it can reach

/agent/ask.docs: Talk to the strat agent (SSE: start|text|tool|tool_done|strat|done|error). Send session_id to continue the conversation

/copy.docs: Create a copy config (target → our hotkey)

/discover.docs: Watch top-N of the on-chain universe (?top=8&kind=validator|nominator|all)

/flows.docs: Inferred trade tape across every tracked trader

/health.docs: Chain health + active RPC + full pool

/leaderboard.docs: Top performers by N-day alpha PnL, ranked out of bt's trader index (?days=7&top=50) — PnL split into market move vs stake flow

/market.docs: Network totals (alpha market cap, 24h volume, block, TAO/USD) + top gainers/losers

/pool.docs: Resize the trader pool (?size=250&refresh=false) — grows in background

/status.docs: Running state, block height, tracked accounts, active copies, and which backend serves reads (bt | rpc)

/strats.docs: Your saved strats (plus public + whitelisted-to-you), or create one. X-Owner-Key header owns them

/strats/backtest.docs: Replay a basket over the last N days (inline basket, no id needed) — equity curve, stats, per-trader contribution

/strats/hub.docs: The public shelf — every published strat

/strats/{id}.docs: Read / replace / delete one strat (writes are owner-only)

/strats/{id}/clone.docs: Copy a readable strat onto your own key, private and flat

/subnets.docs: All subnets, enriched from the bt index (price, 24h/1h change, market cap, volume, sparkline, identity)

/subnets/{netuid}.docs: One subnet: pool state, on-chain identity, validator rankings

/subnets/{netuid}/history.docs: Indexed price/mcap/volume series for a subnet (?hours=168)

/traders.docs: Tracked traders with value, allocation and windowed PnL (from bt's index)

/traders/{ss58}.docs: Indexed profile — positions, equity curve, inferred trades

/universe.docs: Trader-pool status: watched vs on-chain universe size, discovery progress

/wallet/set.docs: Set wallet (mnemonic or seed_hex) — only needed to stake

/whoami.docs: Your strat-owner fingerprint — the id someone whitelists to let you in

/mcp.docs: MCP streamable-HTTP endpoint (JSON-RPC 2.0, batches ok) — 25 tools: every read the strat agent has plus the ops set (ct_copies, ct_create_copy, ct_sync, ct_portfolio, ct_backtest...). `claude mcp add --transport http copytensor <this url>`

/mcp/schema.docs: Transports, scope and the full MCP tool list — read before connecting

/portfolio.docs: The blended book: every sleeve, what it asks for, and the trades that would close the gap (pure read)

/portfolio/sync.docs: Run a portfolio pass now (?dry_run=true previews the identical plan unsigned)

name: copytensor

scopes.all: default over HTTP — reads + the copy book + ct_sync
scopes.agent: COPYTENSOR_MCP_SCOPE=agent — the strat agent's read-only set

mcp.docs: Every tool is a loopback call to a REST route above, so REST and MCP can never disagree. Wallets are never loaded over MCP.
